abstract: An epidemiological study with the aim of establishing the incidence of hydatidiform mole, persistent trophoblastic disease and choriocarcinoma in Stockholm County was performed. Based on the regional cancer registry and hospital registers, the incidence for 1975-1988 was calculated for the number of deliveries as well as the total number of pregnancies. Of the molar pregnancies, 6% were treated with chemotherapy because of invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. Non-molar choriocarcinoma occurred in 1/33,717 deliveries. Difficulties in assessing the incidence of gestational trophoblastic disease are discussed.
abstract_ja: ストックホルム県において、胞状奇胎、持続性栄養膜疾患、絨毛癌の発生率を明らかにするための疫学研究を行った。地域のがん登録と病院の登録データに基づき、1975〜1988年の発生率を分娩数と総妊娠数の両方について算出した。胞状奇胎の6%は侵入奇胎または絨毛癌のために化学療法を受けた。非胞状奇胎性絨毛癌は33,717分娩に1例の頻度で発生した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率算出の難しさについても考察した。
